theorem: For n>=1, a balanced n-tuple with unimodular exponent matrix that admits one cyclic complement in F_n is stably AC-trivial with maximum rank n+1.
reviewed_steps: Nielsen basis with one primitive normal kernel generator
integral kernel generator has tag exponent exactly +/-1
transport of an actual basis-started AC path
Nielsen rows reach the transported initial free basis
triviality_reason: The quotient is cyclic by the complement hypothesis and has zero abelianization by unimodularity.
precise_failure: The two projected kernel words have unimodular abelianization, but their full nonabelian pair need not be a free basis or supplied with an AC certificate.
explicit_no_simplification_example: With complement images a1,a2, Wi=xi Ai(t1,t2)^-1 are part of a domain basis and project to the original relators inverted.
useful_conditional_gates: A verified ordinary AC certificate for the projected tag pair gives maximum rank n+2 for n>=2.
A primitive projected row plus unimodular exponent matrix gives such an ordinary tag certificate.
A stable tag certificate with s extra generators lifts at maximum rank n+2+s; these stabilizations must be counted.
scope: Independent mathematical proof audit plus saved report/hash consistency only. No graph search, AC search, theorem discovery or certificate expansion.
proper_two_complement_feasibility: Conditionally valid existing transfer route; must verify join, marked Nielsen basis/inverses, and tag-pair AC certificate. Proper complement subgroup alone does not rule out an exact return to the input. No search run.
